title: Cloak Amplifier
body: A cloak may only be so big. Each amplifier touching the projector (up to two) raises its limits:
No amplifier: fields up to 32x32 and 16 high, 256 glass blocks, 16 deep. One: 48x48, 24 high, 576 glass, 24 deep. Two: 64x64, 32 high, 1024 glass, 32 deep.
Take an amplifier away from a running cloak that no longer fits and it switches off.
